description: Read-only ranked keyword search across approved Nebula KB sections (compact records; blog hits are title/excerpt only). Use this when you have a query about Nebula knowledge; use nebula_list_knowledge instead to browse without ranking, nebula_get_section instead for one exact path, nebula_get_overview instead for a summary. For full-text search of blog article bodies use nebula_search_blog; for a full article use nebula_get_blog. Returns query, results[{path,score,record}], total, offset, limit, nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of ranked hits to skip (default 0)

query.description: Search words, e.g. "AI SEO for manufacturers"

name: nebula_search_knowledge
title: Search Nebula knowledge
